messages.author: 3908c89e77a099b3
messages.subject: non-linear term
parts:
Hi everyone!,

Is it possible to implement in INLA the following model?:

g(y) ~ beta0 + (beta1 / (beta1 + x))

where x is a continuous predictor, beta0 and beta1 are the parameters to estimate, and g() some generic link function.

If so, could you please provide an example.
Thank you in advance!
Juanmi

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] non-linear term
parts:
Hi,
The inlabru package implements an interactive inla linearisation method where models of this type can be specified. See github.com/inlabru-org/inlabru for more information (the current CRAN version 2.1.13 is a bit old and will soon be replaced by the much improved development version). See the Articles section of the GitHub.io site linked to in the README.

Finn
